companies.name: Persistent Systems
companies.description: Persistent Systems is an Indian multinational technology services company specializing in digital engineering, cloud computing, data analytics, and enterprise AI solutions. The company serves clients across multiple industries globally, with particular strength in healthcare, financial services, and software product engineering.

companies.name: Mphasis
companies.description: Mphasis is an IT services and consulting company applying next-generation technology to help enterprises transform businesses globally. The company specializes in cloud, cognitive computing, and AI-driven solutions across banking, insurance, healthcare, and other industries.

companies.name: Happiest Minds
companies.description: Happiest Minds Technologies is an AI-first digital engineering and IT services company operating across 43 global offices. The company specializes in product engineering, cybersecurity, analytics, and automation platforms, serving clients across financial services, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing.

agents.tagline: AI-powered platform that integrates generative and deterministic AI to revolutionize the entire software development lifecycle from ideation to post-deployment.
agents.description: SASVA 2.0 is Persistent Systems' flagship AI-powered software engineering platform that provides a fully integrated end-to-end solution spanning ideation, assessment, development, deployment, and post-deployment operations. The platform conducts comprehensive project assessments covering technology maturity, security posture, technical debt, and cost/effort forecasting. It uses AI-assisted coding, bug fixing, security enhancements, and context-driven roadmap creation leveraging historical data and market trends. SASVA 2.0 takes a deterministic approach to AI, built around affordability, security, personalization, and responsible AI principles.

use_cases.title: AI-assisted code generation, bug fixing, and security vulnerability remediation
automated product roadmap creation and release planning for product managers
comprehensive project assessment and technical debt analysis
real-time customer support insights and dynamic knowledge base management.

expected_outcomes: 25-35% reduction in release times with improved quality
boost in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

agents.tagline: Enterprise platform for creating, deploying, and governing generative AI applications quickly, efficiently, and responsibly across multiple LLMs.
agents.description: GenAI Hub is Persistent's platform engineered to accelerate the development and deployment of generative AI applications in enterprises. It integrates with existing organizational infrastructure and data while supporting multiple Large Language Models without vendor lock-in. The platform comprises five core components: Playground (a no-code interface for domain experts), Agents Framework (using LangChain and LlamaIndex for RAG solutions), Evaluation Framework (AI-to-validate-AI with drift and bias detection), Gateway (LLM routing with load balancing and cost analysis), and Custom Model Pipelines (for building proprietary LLMs and SLMs). Agent Studio, a companion no-code platform for building AI agents, extends GenAI Hub with visual agent composition and deployment capabilities.

use_cases.title: Enterprise-wide generative AI application development without vendor lock-in
no-code AI agent creation for business users via Agent Studio
secure generative AI chatbot deployment for employee productivity
LLM cost optimization and governance with token-level usage tracking.

expected_outcomes: Accelerated time-to-market for AI applications
reduced operational costs through cross-LLM strategy optimization.

agents.tagline: Agentic AI suite that reimagines how enterprises monitor, maintain, govern, and scale their data ecosystems.
agents.description: iAURA 2.0 is Persistent's agentic AI-driven data management platform that introduces intelligent, automated capabilities for enterprise data operations in the generative AI era. It provides natural-language "talk to your data" interfaces that auto-generate KPIs and visualizations, agentic BI migration tools for moving from legacy platforms (Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Tableau, Spotfire) to modern ones (Power BI, Qlik, QuickSight), and agentic managed services that auto-triage support tickets and resolve data pipeline issues. The platform also includes an AI Data Modeler that parses OLTP data models and recommends data warehouse schemas, and an AI Data Mapper that auto-generates source-to-target data mappings.

use_cases.title: Automated data warehouse modernization and ETL migration
natural-language business intelligence querying and KPI generation
agentic triage and auto-resolution of data pipeline support tickets
legacy BI platform migration to modern cloud-native tools.

expected_outcomes: 55-65% productivity gain in BI migration projects
70% of issues auto-resolved via agentic managed services.

agents.tagline: Multi-agent AI platform built to automate, orchestrate, and elevate service management across IT, HR, Finance, and Procurement.
agents.description: OpsPAilot is Persistent's AI agent platform designed for enterprise service management automation. It boosts agent productivity with real-time, context-enriched answers, smart summarization, and next-best-action recommendations integrated directly within ITSM platforms. The platform uses proprietary reasoning engines and domain-trained models to ensure accuracy and cost efficiency across multiple business functions. It features the TRAPS+ Framework for built-in audit trails, privacy, and governance meeting regulatory and ethical standards. OpsPAilot's open architecture supports any environment including AWS, Azure, GCP, hybrid, or on-premises deployments.

use_cases.title: Automated IT service desk ticket resolution with next-best-action guidance
HR and finance service request automation and orchestration
cross-functional procurement workflow management
intelligent escalation and knowledge summarization for support agents.

expected_outcomes: 80% faster processing
90% accuracy gains
50% cost reduction.

agents.tagline: AI-driven contract management solution that consolidates workflows into a centralized Microsoft Teams dashboard with conversational AI.
agents.description: ContractAssIst is an AI-powered contract management solution that addresses enterprise challenges in tracking and managing high-volume contracts from multiple vendors. It features an AI-powered chatbot enabling conversational queries and intelligent suggestions within Microsoft Teams group chats, a centralized dashboard for unified contract access, real-time version tracking, contract comparison capabilities, and automated approval summaries. The solution leverages GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 via Azure OpenAI Service for natural language contract analysis, with Elastic and Application Insights for observability. ContractAssIst is available on the Microsoft AppSource marketplace.

use_cases.title: Centralized multi-vendor contract tracking and compliance management
AI-powered contract comparison and clause analysis
automated approval workflow management with instant notifications
conversational contract querying within Microsoft Teams.

expected_outcomes: 95% reduction in email communication overhead
20-25 minutes saved per user daily through streamlined workflows.

agents.tagline: A unified AI platform that orchestrates agentic solutions to perpetually rewire enterprise core systems for continuous transformation.
agents.description: Mphasis NeoIP is a unified AI platform that integrates multiple Mphasis AI solutions into a single orchestration layer for end-to-end enterprise transformation. It is powered by the Ontosphere, a dynamic ontology-based knowledge graph that encodes contextual enterprise intelligence across domain-specific areas. The platform connects via Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) standards for cross-enterprise orchestration. NeoIP spans the full IT value chain from application modernization and development to IT operations, coordinating sub-agents such as NeoZeta, NeoSaBa, NeoCrux, NeoRigal, and AIOps.

use_cases.title: End-to-end legacy modernization orchestration across distributed teams
continuous AI-driven application development and quality automation
proactive IT operations management with self-healing capabilities
enterprise-wide knowledge capture and reuse through ontology-powered graphs.

expected_outcomes: Up to 60% improvement in development and modernization efficiency
50% reduction in mean time to detect and resolve incidents
3-5 hours early warning for major outages via anomaly detection.

agents.tagline: A generative AI-based enterprise modernization platform that transforms legacy application re-learning from a black-box process into a transparent, knowledge-graph-driven journey.
agents.description: Mphasis NeoZeta is a proprietary generative AI platform natively powered by Google Gemini that addresses the challenge of enterprise application modernization. It harvests business knowledge from both code and non-code technical artifacts, building an evergreen knowledge graph of applications that enables efficient querying and retrieval of critical application information. The platform functions as an IDE extension, reducing re-learning time by over 50% while supporting multiple legacy languages including COBOL, C++, Natural, and Java. NeoZeta avoids black-box conversions, providing users with full transparency into the modernization process and enabling subject matter expert validations throughout the journey.

use_cases.title: Mainframe-to-cloud migration with preserved business logic
legacy COBOL application modernization with knowledge extraction
cross-language application re-platforming with transparent traceability
enterprise knowledge graph creation from decades-old codebases.

expected_outcomes: 60%+ reduction in modernization time and costs
over 50% reduction in re-learning time through AI-assisted knowledge extraction.

agents.tagline: A GenAI-powered modern engineering platform that unifies fragmented development tools into a single ecosystem with AI-assisted coding and quality automation.
agents.description: Mphasis NeoCrux is a generative AI-powered engineering platform that consolidates disparate SDLC tools into a single-pane-of-glass view, eliminating tool-switching overhead for developers. The platform orchestrates multiple third-party AI coding assistants including GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Google Gemini Code Assist, and Sourcegraph Cody under a unified interface. Its Intelligent Context Generation engine provides task-specific prompts that normalize AI usage quality across developer experience levels. NeoCrux also features GPU-accelerated code generation with Nvidia support and value stream integration for seamless data exchange across development lifecycle stages.

use_cases.title: Accelerated enterprise software delivery with AI-assisted coding across multiple models
unified developer experience across fragmented engineering toolchains
security incident response through consolidated visibility
reusable asset discovery and adoption across engineering teams.

expected_outcomes: 3X go-to-market acceleration
40% productivity enhancement via GenAI automation
30% increase in reusable asset adoption.

agents.tagline: An agentic AI platform that transforms legacy system insights and product visions into structured agile artifacts with automated epic, story, and test case generation.
agents.description: Mphasis NeoSaBa is an agentic AI platform designed to empower product owners and domain experts by automating the creation of agile development artifacts. It generates INVEST-compliant epics, features, user stories, and tasks from knowledge bases, with built-in validation and improvement suggestions. The platform integrates with NeoZeta to map legacy system dependencies, business logic, and capabilities, preserving domain knowledge as structured agile requirements. NeoSaBa also automatically generates Gherkin test cases for user stories and captures business process flows with embedded rules. It supports both greenfield product development and legacy modernization scenarios with bi-directional synchronization to project management tools.

use_cases.title: Greenfield product development from vision to detailed agile specifications
architecture modernization with automated requirement extraction from legacy codebases
agile enablement for IT teams transitioning from waterfall methodologies
automated test case generation from user stories for behavior-driven development.

expected_outcomes: Accelerated delivery through automated artifact generation
reduced ambiguity and improved traceability in modernization projects.

agents.tagline: An integrated agentic IT operations platform that shifts enterprises from reactive incident management to proactive, self-healing automation powered by AI.
agents.description: Mphasis AIOps is an enterprise platform that modernizes IT operations through agentic AI-driven automation, observability, and service reliability engineering. It processes logs, metrics, traces, and events to perform event correlation, automated root cause analysis, and full incident lifecycle management. The platform features self-healing automation with anomaly detection and automated remediation, along with a generative AI-powered service desk with conversational bots integrated across chat, voice, and email channels. AIOps also includes Digital Employee Experience tools enabling end-user self-service and intelligent routing with contextual knowledge delivery.

use_cases.title: Proactive incident prediction and prevention with 3-5 hour early warning for major outages
automated root cause analysis and self-healing remediation for infrastructure incidents
AI-powered service desk with omni-channel conversational support
DevSecOps pipeline integration for secure and scalable operations management.

expected_outcomes: 67% accuracy in major incident prediction
50% reduction in mean time to resolution
up to 40% reduction in operational effort and 30% savings in infrastructure management costs.

agents.tagline: An agentic AI platform that reasons through quality engineering requests and dynamically orchestrates testing capabilities across the entire software development lifecycle.
agents.description: IQE is a four-layer AI-powered quality engineering solution that provides total quality orchestration from development through post-release monitoring. It delivers persona-centric, context-aware experiences tailored to different user roles (developers, QA leads, executives) within a modular and extensible architecture. The platform includes a Prompt Engineering Studio for AI-driven test creation, an API Journey Builder for customizable API testing, and a Unified Test Intelligence Hub aggregating functional, performance, security, and digital experience testing. It combines rule-based approaches with cognitive AI methods using machine learning and NLP-powered quality analytics, and integrates into enterprise DevOps/CI/CD processes.

use_cases.title: Automated test generation and execution across enterprise applications
quality assurance for COTS platforms such as Salesforce and Workday
continuous post-deployment quality monitoring and anomaly detection
GenAI-powered request/response validation for API and business process testing.

expected_outcomes: Reduced manual test creation effort through AI-driven prompt-based test generation
accelerated release cycles via unified test intelligence and continuous monitoring.

agents.tagline: A scalable generative AI solution that automates labor-intensive research workflows and enables real-time collaboration across organizations.
agents.description: GenAI Research Companion is a proprietary platform that automates tasks such as summarizing research papers, managing research projects, and facilitating real-time collaboration across teams. The solution includes enterprise-grade security with advanced authentication protocols, real-time notifications, and robust feedback modules for iterative improvement. The platform is designed as a reusable solution that can be adapted across different research domains and organizational contexts, supporting both medical and corporate research workflows. It handles multi-format document ingestion, structured summarization, and cross-team knowledge sharing within a governed environment.

use_cases.title: Automated medical research documentation analysis and paper summarization
cross-functional team collaboration on complex research initiatives
project management and synthesis for research organizations
legal and financial research document analysis and insight generation.

expected_outcomes: Enhanced research efficiency through automated paper summarization
streamlined time-intensive project management and cross-team collaboration processes.

agents.tagline: A Gen-AI-powered managed detection and response platform that identifies and remediates cyber threats at three times the speed of traditional processes.
agents.description: Secureline360 is a packaged MDR (Managed Detection and Response) service built on the Gen-AI-powered CRPP platform. It employs behavioral threat analytics, AI-driven detection, and automated remediation assistance to provide real-time threat visibility and 24/7 monitoring. The platform integrates with the proprietary SecAiGenie engine for handling complex and unprecedented security incidents, and maps threats against the MITRE ATT&CK framework. Secureline360 is offered in three deployment models: MSSP NGSIEM MDR (QRadar-based), XDR MDR, and MS Sentinel-based MDR services.

use_cases.title: 24/7 automated threat hunting and proactive cyber defense for enterprises
real-time incident detection, triage, and automated remediation
compliance monitoring and security posture management with customized playbooks
threat intelligence integration with MITRE ATT&CK mapping.

expected_outcomes: 3X faster remediation time compared to traditional MDR processes
98% reduction in alert noise.
